findings.issue: Baseline comparisons only run when not in validation-only mode, skipping HGB evaluation
findings.why_it_matters: The 'before_feature' baseline comparison block is guarded by 'not validation_only' so HGB model never gets this critical baseline evaluation despite being the main model

findings.issue: Missing random seed for pipeline reproducibility across all steps
findings.why_it_matters: Only HGB has random_state=0; Ridge and data loading lack documented seeds per reproducibility requirement

findings.issue: Training mean baseline not reported with Ridge and HGB models
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction requires training-mean AND yesterday-count baselines next to every model score, but report only includes baseline_persistence
